about: Settings and permissions the Tester Assistant reads (read-only, on the Run-on environment) BEFORE it writes a test: they decide which options and buttons a screen shows. {{username}} = the environment's login user.

sources.label: Profile permissions of the login user (Settings > Profile > Edit)
sources.sql: SELECT p.* FROM employee emp JOIN profile p ON p.id_profile = emp.id_profile WHERE emp.username = '{{username}}'

sources.label: Employee settings of the login user (Settings > Employee settings)
sources.sql: SELECT es.* FROM employee emp JOIN employee_settings es ON es.id_employee = emp.id_employee WHERE emp.username = '{{username}}'

sources.label: Login user (branch: NULL or 0 = all branches)
sources.sql: SELECT emp.id_employee, emp.username, emp.id_branch, emp.id_profile FROM employee emp WHERE emp.username = '{{username}}'

sources.label: Retail settings (Settings > Retail settings), name = value
sources.sql: SELECT name, value FROM ret_settings ORDER BY name

sources.label: Business date per branch (day-close date = eTail's 'today')
sources.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id_branch, '=', DATE_FORMAT(entry_date, '%d-%m-%Y')) ORDER BY id_branch SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ret_day_closing
